title: cochange components [--propose] --json
description: The component map: the configured `components`, or the map inferred from folders when none is configured (`--propose` always prints the inferred map). It reads the tree at the analysed ref and no history.

source.description: Whether the map is the `components` of code-health.json or was inferred from folders.

productionFiles.description: Production code files at the analysed ref: code, not tests, not excluded, not generated, not vendored.

filesInNoComponent.description: Production code files that match no component.

proposal.description: Only with `--propose`: the inferred map as a `components` block to paste into code-health.json after review.

results.description: One row per component, ordered by group (components with no group last) and then name.

group.description: The independent tree the component belongs to, such as `src` or `test`; null when the config states none.

files.description: Production code files in the component.
